name: ZCA_EXP_MAP_OBJECTS
description: The table contains one record for each export object included in a mapping.

columns.name: MAP_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: This column is the Primary Key for this table.

columns.name: ENABLED_MAP_OBJECT
columns.description: Signify chosen Hierarchy Export Object in Export Object Page

columns.name: MAP_OBJECT_NUMBER
columns.description: This columns is the Forgine Key for Map Objects

columns.name: EXPORT_MAP_ID
columns.description: Mapping id.  Foreign key to ZCA_EXT_MAPS.EXPORT_MAP_ID

columns.name: OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Internal name of the exportable object.  Foreign key to ZCA_EXP_OBJECTS

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: VIEW_CRITERIA
columns.description: stores  view criteria information  for the export map object.

columns.name: PARENT_OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: This column represents the Parent Object Code of a child object.

columns.name: COLUMN_ORDER
columns.description: This column has been created to maintain the order by details passed by the user in the REST/UI during Export for Simplified Export

columns.name: OBJECT_LEVEL
columns.description: Column holds the level of the system task. Parent Level system task will be 1, next child level will be 2 and so on.

columns.name: VIEW_CRITERIA_NAME
columns.description: stores  view criteria name information  for the export map object.

columns.name: FILTER_VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: stores  flag Y or N to show  view criteria in UI.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
